( a ) cirāyanta, mf (~antī) n. , Ja V 91, 27´ (maṃ ~antiṃ viditva); Dhp-a III 75, 5 (bodhisatto pi taṃ ~antaṃ disvā Candakumāraṃ pesesi); 75, 9 ; ( b ) cirāyamāna, mfn. , Ja V 93, 9´ ; Mp I 425, 15 ; — neg. acirāyamāna, mfn. , Pj II 349, 14 (acirāyamāno vacanaṃ bhāsa) ≠ Th-a III 200, 29 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ataramāno, prob. wr ); — aor. 2 sg. cirāyi, Ja VI 280, 4 (tena hi deva mā ~i); Dhp-a III 305, 1 (sace maṃ ativiya je ~ī ti tajjetvā patodalaṭṭhiyā paharissati, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se cirāyitan ti) = Vv-a 64, 25 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~atī ti, prob. wr ); Ud-a 313, 16 (evaṃ ciraṃ akāsī ti evaṃ ~i, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr cirā si); 3 pl. cirāyiṃsu, Ps II 291, 4 (dhātiyo khajjabhojjantare vicaramānā thokaṃ ~iṃsu); 2 pl. cirāyittha, Ja III 36, 18 (te āgacchante disvā kiṃ ~itthā ti pucchi); — absol. cirāyitvā, Ud-a 313, 26 ; Vv-a 208, 15 (tvaṃ ajja udakatitthaṃ gatā ~itvā āgatā); — pp cirāyita , ( mf ) n. , delaying; there was delay ; Dhp-a I 308, 9 (imasmiṃ te vāre ~an ti); III 305, 1 (maṃ ativiya je ~an ti tajjetvā, Ee so; Se te ~an ti; Be, Ce je cirāyī ti); — ~-tta, n., abstr. , delaying ; Ps III 449, 17 (dandhāyitattan ti ayaṃ nu kho maggo ayaṃ nu kho ti kaṅkhāvasena ~-ttaṃ); — see also aticirāyati.
